gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: The kids made ___ a story about a stolen dog.
gaps.explanation: make up = invent (a story, excuse). Compare make up for = compensate.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
It's hard to keep ___ with the latest slang.
gaps.explanation: keep up with = stay level with somebody/something changing.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
